sections.heading: Chief Complaints & Brief History
sections.cue: Complaints: fever with chills for 3 days. History: known diabetic

sections.heading: Diagnosis / Clinical Impression
sections.cue: Diagnosis: viral fever. Impression: likely dengue

sections.heading: Investigations Advised
sections.cue: Investigations: CBC, serum creatinine, USG abdomen

sections.heading: Rx (MEDICATIONS)
sections.cue: Medication: Tab. Dolo 650, 1-0-1, after food, 5 days

sections.heading: Dietary & General Advice
sections.cue: Advice: plenty of fluids, low salt diet
